Keep domestic tracking numbers with the seller records and the international tracking number with the eventual parcel. It makes both your accounts and your delivery inquiries easier to follow.
corrections.translation: Jika penjual membagi pesanan menjadi dua kiriman, dua nomor resi tidak otomatis berarti Anda membayar dua ongkos kirim. Periksa rincian pesanan yang sebenarnya. Menggabungkan dua pembelian di gudang agen mengubah paket keluar, tetapi tidak mengubah pembayaran domestik yang sudah terjadi. Simpan nomor resi domestik dengan data penjual dan nomor internasional dengan paket akhirnya. Pembukuan dan pertanyaan pengiriman akan lebih mudah ditelusuri.

corrections.source: Create a row for the proposed parcel and list which purchases it contains. Add destination, route, packed weight and outer dimensions when known. Mark each value as measured or estimated. An estimate using a seller's product weight and an estimated box size has a different evidential basis from a quote based on a packed parcel. Preserve the inputs when you save a quote. The result alone cannot explain a later difference.
corrections.translation: Buat satu baris untuk calon paket dan daftarkan barang yang direncanakan masuk. Tambahkan tujuan, rute, berat setelah dikemas, dan ukuran luar bila diketahui. Tandai setiap angka sebagai hasil ukur atau perkiraan. Perkiraan dari berat produk penjual dan dugaan ukuran kotak berbeda dasarnya dengan penawaran setelah paket selesai dikemas. Saat menyimpan perkiraan, simpan masukan yang dipakai agar perubahan di kemudian hari bisa dijelaskan.

corrections.source: A change of route can affect the charge, eligible contents and delivery assumptions. To compare prices, keep the destination, units, weight and dimensions fixed. Note which services are included in each quote. A figure that includes an optional service cannot be compared fairly with a figure that omits the same service unless you explain the difference. If a route will not accept the parcel as described, mark it unavailable instead of treating its displayed price as a viable saving.
corrections.translation: Pergantian rute bisa mengubah biaya, jenis isi yang diterima, dan asumsi pengiriman. Saat membandingkan harga, pertahankan tujuan, satuan, berat, dan dimensi yang sama. Catat layanan yang sudah termasuk. Jika hanya satu perkiraan mencakup layanan tambahan, jelaskan perbedaannya. Apabila rute tidak menerima paket dengan spesifikasi tersebut, tandai tidak tersedia; harga yang tercantum bukan penghematan yang bisa digunakan.

corrections.source: Size can matter as much as scale weight. A lightweight bag stuffed to preserve its shape may need a larger carton than the same bag packed flat. If the route considers dimensions when setting its billing weight, these are two different shipping scenarios. Ask how each would be packed and whether that method would protect the item. An attractive figure obtained by typing an unrealistically small box into a calculator does not tell you how much it will cost to send the parcel you actually want.
corrections.translation: Ukuran bisa sama pentingnya dengan berat timbangan. Tas ringan yang diisi agar tetap berbentuk mungkin memerlukan kardus lebih besar daripada tas yang dikemas rata. Jika rute memperhitungkan dimensi untuk menentukan berat tagihan, itu dua skenario berbeda. Tanyakan cara pengemasan dan apakah barang tetap terlindungi. Harga rendah dari ukuran kardus yang tidak realistis tidak menunjukkan biaya paket yang sebenarnya Anda perlukan.

corrections.source: If you simply need the total cash commitment, stop at the parcel total. Allocation is useful when friends are splitting a shipment or you are comparing the delivered costs of individual pieces. Agree on the rule before paying. An equal split by seller unit is easy to explain, but two shirts and a bulky bag do not necessarily use equal space. Splitting by item value answers a different question again. None of these conventions changes what the carrier charges for the whole parcel.
corrections.translation: Jika Anda hanya memerlukan total uang yang harus dibayar, cukup gunakan total paket. Pembagian ongkos berguna ketika beberapa teman mengirim bersama atau Anda ingin membandingkan harga akhir per barang. Sepakati aturan sebelum membayar. Pembagian rata per unit mudah dijelaskan, tetapi dua kemeja dan tas besar belum tentu memakai ruang yang sama. Pembagian menurut nilai barang juga punya dasar berbeda. Semua metode ini tidak mengubah tagihan pengangkut untuk satu paket.

corrections.source: Keep the original currency on every confirmed payment. If the spreadsheet displays a converted estimate, record the original price too. For a budget in your home currency, apply one stated planning rate to amounts in the same currency. Save the actual amount charged separately when your payment settles. An agent display rate, a payment provider's conversion and a card statement can describe different parts of the transaction. Do not apply a second currency conversion to an amount you already copied from your home-currency statement.
corrections.translation: Pertahankan mata uang asli pada setiap pembayaran yang sudah pasti. Jika lembar kerja menampilkan estimasi hasil konversi, tulis juga harga aslinya. Untuk anggaran dalam mata uang Anda, gunakan satu kurs perencanaan yang jelas bagi nilai dalam mata uang yang sama. Catat terpisah jumlah yang benar-benar ditagih setelah transaksi selesai. Kurs tampilan agen, konversi penyedia pembayaran, dan mutasi kartu dapat mewakili tahap berbeda. Jangan mengonversi lagi angka yang sudah tercatat dalam mata uang Anda di laporan kartu.

corrections.source: If you return an item, record the credit against the specific purchase and note where it was received. An account balance credit changes what you can spend through that account. It does not necessarily create an incoming transfer on the original card statement. Once an item leaves a planned parcel, recalculate the outbound scenario rather than assuming freight decreases by that item's original allocation. A different mix of pieces can still need the same carton or can qualify for a different route.
corrections.translation: Jika barang dikembalikan, pasangkan pengkreditan dana dengan pembelian terkait dan catat tempat dana diterima. Saldo akun yang bertambah mengubah daya belanja melalui akun tersebut, tetapi belum tentu menimbulkan transfer masuk ke kartu asal. Ketika barang dikeluarkan dari calon paket, hitung ulang skenario kirim. Ongkosnya belum tentu turun sebesar jatah biaya barang itu karena barang tersisa mungkin masih memerlukan kardus yang sama atau bisa memakai rute lain.

corrections.source: Bring the purchase orders, packing selections and actual parcel charge back to your original sheet. Replace estimates in a new column so you can see why your budget changed. Identify whether each difference comes from the seller option, quantity, domestic delivery, optional packing, measured parcel, route or currency. If a final line is still unclear, send support the relevant reference and the two figures you are trying to reconcile. Asking about one charge on one record is easier to resolve than asking why the whole order felt expensive.
corrections.translation: Cocokkan pesanan pembelian, pilihan kemasan, dan tagihan paket sebenarnya dengan lembar kerja awal. Masukkan angka akhir pada kolom baru agar perubahan masih dapat dilacak ke versi, jumlah barang, kirim domestik, kemasan tambahan, hasil ukur, rute, atau kurs. Jika satu baris masih tidak jelas, kirim nomor terkait dan dua angka yang hendak dicocokkan kepada petugas. Satu pertanyaan tentang biaya tertentu lebih mudah diselidiki daripada pertanyaan umum tentang mahalnya seluruh pesanan.

corrections.source: OOTDBuy's Help Center separates purchasing services and fees from delivery charges and packaging. Consult the relevant topic and the current checkout for transaction-specific terms. When those records agree, the spreadsheet has done its job. You can explain what you bought, what you paid to move it and how much remains an estimate. That is a much stronger basis for choosing the next find than comparing two attractive catalogue prices in isolation.
corrections.translation: Pusat Bantuan OOTDBuy membahas layanan dan biaya pembelian secara terpisah dari pengiriman dan pengemasan. Untuk ketentuan suatu transaksi, lihat topik terkait dan halaman pembayaran terkini. Jika catatannya sesuai, Anda dapat menjelaskan apa yang dibeli, berapa ongkos memindahkannya, dan apa yang masih perkiraan. Dasar ini lebih bermanfaat untuk memilih barang berikutnya dibanding hanya membandingkan dua harga katalog.

corrections.source: A jacket, a narrow boxed accessory and a rigid bag may fit in the same shipping carton, but fitting is only one part of a packing decision. Before choosing a service, decide which shapes must survive, what can touch and what would become expensive or impossible to replace. A good request describes those conditions clearly enough that the warehouse can tell you whether its available packing options meet them.
corrections.translation: Jaket, aksesori dalam kotak ramping, dan tas kaku mungkin muat dalam satu kardus. Sebelum memilih layanan, tentukan bentuk yang harus dipertahankan, permukaan mana yang boleh bersentuhan, dan bagian mana yang sulit atau mahal diganti. Jelaskan kondisi tersebut agar gudang dapat menilai apakah opsi pengemasan yang tersedia memenuhi kebutuhan Anda.

corrections.source: Draw three columns on a piece of paper: item, vulnerable feature and acceptable change. For a jacket, the vulnerable feature might be a raised print that should not be creased sharply. For a bag, it might be a structured corner or a handle that needs support. For the accessory, the retail box might be part of a gift. A simple list of product names misses all three distinctions. Writing down the features helps you decide what original packaging can reasonably be removed.
corrections.translation: Buat tiga kolom: barang, bagian yang rentan, dan perubahan yang dapat diterima. Pada jaket mungkin ada sablon timbul yang tidak boleh terlipat tajam. Pada tas, sudut berstruktur atau gagang mungkin memerlukan penyangga. Pada aksesori, kotak penjualan mungkin bagian dari hadiah. Daftar nama barang saja tidak menangkap ketiga kebutuhan itu. Catatan tentang cirinya membantu Anda memilih lapisan kemasan yang aman dibuang.

corrections.source: Check the quantity and the intended destination of each piece. A compact accessory placed inside a bag can be easy to forget when parcel contents are checked. If an item belongs to a friend, find out whether that person wants the box, spare parts or protective cover. One buyer's unnecessary packaging may be another buyer's essential presentation box. Agree on those details before asking for anything to be discarded; an instruction to remove packaging is difficult to reverse after disposal.
corrections.translation: Periksa jumlah dan penerima akhir setiap barang. Aksesori kecil yang diselipkan ke dalam tas mudah terlupakan saat memeriksa isi paket. Jika itu milik teman, tanyakan apakah ia menginginkan kotak, suku cadang, atau penutup pelindung. Yang dianggap kemasan berlebihan oleh seseorang mungkin justru kotak hadiah yang penting bagi orang lain. Sepakati dahulu sebelum memberi perintah pembuangan karena kemasan yang sudah terbuang sulit dikembalikan.

corrections.source: Imagine you put a metal buckle against an unprotected smooth bag. The buckle takes up little room, yet its edge may mark the larger piece if the contents shift. A hard rectangular retail box can push into a structured corner in the same way. The packing question is not simply which item is heavier. It is where the weight can concentrate and which surfaces can rub. Ask for separation around the vulnerable parts if the available service allows it.
corrections.translation: Bayangkan gesper logam menempel pada permukaan halus tas tanpa pelindung. Gesper memakan sedikit ruang, tetapi tepinya dapat membekas ketika isi bergeser. Sudut kotak penjualan yang kaku juga bisa menekan sudut tas berstruktur. Pertimbangannya adalah di mana tekanan terkumpul dan permukaan mana yang saling bergesekan. Jika layanannya memungkinkan, minta pemisah di sekitar bagian yang rentan.

corrections.source: Soft clothing can sometimes occupy unused space, but a soft item is not automatically suitable as protective material. A pale jacket next to an exposed dark surface, a garment with decorative studs, or a bulky item that presses a handle out of shape creates its own problems. If preserving a signature fold or a retail presentation matters, say so explicitly. Give the packer the goal, such as keeping hardware away from the coated face, instead of prescribing an elaborate arrangement the warehouse may be unable to offer.
corrections.translation: Pakaian lunak kadang dapat mengisi ruang kosong, tetapi belum tentu cocok sebagai pelindung. Jaket pucat yang bersentuhan dengan permukaan gelap, pakaian berhias paku dekoratif, atau benda tebal yang menekan gagang bisa menimbulkan masalah baru. Jika lipatan khas atau tampilan asli kemasan penting, sebutkan. Berikan tujuan yang jelas, seperti menjauhkan komponen logam dari permukaan berlapis, tanpa memaksakan susunan rumit yang mungkin tidak bisa dilakukan gudang.

corrections.source: Examine what the original box or insert does. An insert can hold a rigid handle in position, keep two pieces apart or keep a small component from vanishing. A larger outer sleeve might mainly add empty volume. Treat them as separate decisions. “Keep the shaped insert and the accessory pouch; the outer display sleeve can be removed if permitted” is more informative than “remove boxes.” If the warehouse offers only broad choices, ask what the selected option actually removes.
corrections.translation: Periksa fungsi kotak asli dan sisipannya. Sisipan dapat menahan gagang kaku, memisahkan dua komponen, atau mencegah bagian kecil tercecer. Selubung luar untuk pajangan mungkin terutama menambah volume kosong. Putuskan setiap lapisan tersendiri: “Pertahankan sisipan cetak dan kantong aksesori. Selubung pajangan luar boleh dilepas jika diperbolehkan.” Jika gudang hanya menawarkan pilihan umum, tanyakan apa yang sebenarnya akan dilepas.

corrections.source: A pending exchange can change the decision. If an item is the wrong size or you have an unresolved inspection question, check the applicable return instructions before changing its packaging. Even when you plan to keep the item, a protected piece might be easier to inspect in its existing arrangement. Save an overview before approving an irreversible packing change if you need a record. For the packing services currently offered for the actual parcel, consult the Delivery and Packaging information in OOTDBuy and the choices shown at submission.
corrections.translation: Penukaran yang masih dipertimbangkan dapat mengubah keputusan. Jika ukuran salah atau pemeriksaan belum tuntas, cek petunjuk pengembalian sebelum mengganti kemasan. Meski Anda berniat menyimpan barang, bagian terlindung mungkin lebih mudah diperiksa dalam susunan semula. Jika perlu bukti, simpan foto keseluruhan sebelum menyetujui perubahan permanen. Untuk paket Anda, lihat informasi Pengiriman dan Pengemasan OOTDBuy serta opsi saat mengajukan pengiriman.

corrections.source: Build one scenario that combines all eligible items and one that separates the piece with special needs. Record the destination, the items, the proposed protection and what measurements are known. If a route excludes an item or the resulting parcel exceeds an applicable size limit, remove that route from the comparison. There is little value in computing the cheapest version of a shipment that cannot use the selected service. Keep earlier estimates with their original date and assumptions.
corrections.translation: Susun dua skenario: satukan semua barang yang memenuhi syarat, atau pisahkan barang yang memerlukan perlindungan khusus. Catat tujuan, isi, perlindungan yang diusulkan, dan ukuran yang diketahui. Keluarkan dari perbandingan rute yang melarang salah satu barang atau yang batas ukurannya terlampaui. Mencari harga termurah untuk kiriman yang tidak diterima layanan itu tidak membantu. Simpan estimasi lama bersama tanggal dan asumsi awal.

corrections.source: If the decision turns on whether the bag travels upright or with its handle folded, ask that question directly. If it turns on freight, ask whether the dimensions you are comparing are estimated item dimensions or measured outer carton dimensions. Mixing those two produces a confident-looking comparison that answers very little. A useful request also lists what you are willing to change. The warehouse may be able to suggest a supported packing option once it knows which trade-offs are acceptable.
corrections.translation: Jika pilihan Anda bergantung pada apakah tas dikirim tegak atau dengan gagang terlipat, tanyakan hal itu langsung. Jika ongkos menjadi penentu, pastikan angka yang dibandingkan adalah perkiraan ukuran produk atau hasil ukur kardus luar. Mencampur keduanya menghasilkan angka yang tampak meyakinkan tetapi tidak dapat dipakai sebagai pembanding. Jelaskan juga perubahan yang Anda izinkan agar gudang dapat menawarkan pilihan yang sesuai.

corrections.source: Here is a sample private order note: “Please keep the insert in the structured bag and the small accessory in its retail box. Please separate the buckle from the bag's coated front. The jacket may be folded, with the raised print kept flat if practical. If these items cannot be combined using the available service, please let me know before changing their retail packing.” Replace these details with your actual priorities. Do not include instructions that assume a particular service is free or guaranteed.
corrections.translation: Contoh catatan pribadi: “Mohon pertahankan sisipan pada tas berstruktur dan simpan aksesori kecil dalam kotak penjualannya. Pisahkan gesper dari permukaan depan tas yang berlapis. Jaket boleh dilipat; usahakan sablon timbulnya tetap rata. Jika barang-barang ini tidak dapat digabung dengan layanan yang tersedia, beri tahu saya sebelum mengubah kemasan penjualannya.” Sesuaikan dengan kebutuhan sendiri dan jangan menganggap layanan tertentu gratis atau pasti tersedia.

corrections.source: Look at the warehouse references selected for the outbound parcel, especially when you own multiple versions of the same item. A recent replacement may have a different entry from the unit originally photographed. Check the address, delivery route, protection selections and any optional service charges together. Identify charges that apply to the whole carton and those attached to individual pieces. Save the confirmed selection with the item list so the final statement can be compared with the right scenario.
corrections.translation: Periksa nomor barang gudang yang dipilih untuk paket keluar, terutama jika Anda memiliki beberapa versi produk serupa. Barang pengganti mungkin punya catatan berbeda dari unit yang dahulu difoto. Periksa alamat, rute, perlindungan, dan biaya layanan tambahan sekaligus. Bedakan biaya untuk seluruh kardus dan biaya per barang. Simpan pilihan yang telah dikonfirmasi bersama daftar isi agar tagihan akhir dibandingkan dengan skenario yang benar.

corrections.source: If a packed view is available, read it with the inventory beside you. Can you identify the rigid bag, the separate accessory and the jacket? Are any protective choices visible? A sealed-box view cannot tell you where the buckle sits. Treat the photograph according to what it shows and ask about a missing detail before dispatch if that detail would change your decision. A request for repeated pictures of an already sealed carton is unlikely to answer an internal placement question.
corrections.translation: Jika ada foto setelah pengemasan, baca sambil melihat daftar barang. Dapatkah Anda mengenali tas kaku, aksesori lepas, dan jaket? Apakah pelindung yang dipilih terlihat? Foto kardus tertutup tidak menunjukkan letak gesper. Simpulkan hanya yang tampak dan tanyakan detail yang penting sebelum dikirim. Meminta berulang kali foto kardus yang sudah disegel kecil kemungkinannya menjawab pertanyaan tentang susunan bagian dalam.

corrections.source: When the parcel arrives, compare its label to your outbound reference. If something appears damaged, document the outer condition and internal protection as you uncover them. Keep the packaging while you consult the applicable after-sales instructions. If everything arrives as expected, write down what worked. A note such as “shaped insert preserved the bag; display sleeve was unnecessary for my use” is more transferable to your next mixed parcel than a bare freight total.
corrections.translation: Saat paket tiba, cocokkan label dengan nomor paket keluar. Jika terlihat kerusakan, dokumentasikan kondisi luar dan pelindung di dalam saat Anda membuka kemasan. Simpan kemasan sambil memeriksa ketentuan purnajual. Jika semua sesuai, catat apa yang berhasil. “Sisipan cetak menjaga bentuk tas; selubung pajangan tidak saya perlukan” lebih membantu untuk kiriman campuran berikutnya daripada hanya menyimpan jumlah ongkos kirim.

corrections.source: The most useful packing decision is one you can explain before and after the journey. You know which pieces are travelling together, which features deserve protection and which dimensions affect the quote. You have also made clear what may be removed and what needs your approval. With those details on record, a change in route or box size becomes a decision you can evaluate, instead of a surprise you discover after the parcel has gone.
corrections.translation: Keputusan pengemasan yang baik dapat Anda jelaskan sebelum dan sesudah perjalanan. Anda mengetahui barang mana yang dikirim bersama, ciri apa yang perlu dilindungi, dan ukuran apa yang memengaruhi penawaran. Anda juga telah menentukan bagian yang boleh dilepas dan perubahan yang memerlukan persetujuan. Dengan catatan itu, perubahan rute atau kotak dapat dinilai sebelum paket berangkat.

corrections.source: Your order page says delivered, yet there is no parcel at your door. Before treating that as a failed delivery, find out which journey ended. A seller can deliver a purchase to an agent's warehouse well before an international parcel exists. An overseas carrier can also hand a shipment to another operator for the final address. A useful tracking note connects the latest event to the parcel, journey and operator it actually describes.
corrections.translation: Halaman pesanan menunjukkan “terkirim”, tetapi tidak ada paket di depan pintu. Periksa perjalanan mana yang selesai. Penjual bisa sudah mengantar pembelian ke gudang agen sebelum paket internasional dibuat. Pengangkut internasional juga bisa menyerahkan paket ke operator lain untuk pengantaran akhir. Catatan pelacakan sebaiknya menghubungkan peristiwa terakhir dengan paket, tahap perjalanan, dan operator yang memang dimaksud.

corrections.source: Open your OOTDBuy records and identify the international parcel containing the missing item. Check which warehouse items you selected for that parcel. If two garments were paid for together but submitted for delivery separately, the first parcel's tracking cannot answer where the second garment is. Write down the outbound parcel reference, route as displayed, destination country and carrier tracking reference. Keep your address and full tracking number inside your private notes and the official assistance channel.
corrections.translation: Buka catatan OOTDBuy dan temukan paket internasional tempat barang yang dicari seharusnya dimasukkan. Cocokkan daftar barang gudangnya. Jika dua pakaian dibayar bersama tetapi dikirim terpisah, pelacakan paket pertama tidak menunjukkan posisi pakaian kedua. Catat nomor paket keluar, nama rute yang tampil, negara tujuan, dan nomor resi pengangkut. Simpan alamat dan resi lengkap hanya di catatan pribadi serta kanal bantuan resmi yang privat.

corrections.source: If you cannot find an outbound parcel containing the item, check whether it is still a warehouse entry or awaiting a separate action on your part. A domestic tracking number from the seller may show a delivery at an address in China. That can be consistent with the purchase reaching the agent before you arrange its next journey. Compare the order record with the warehouse intake. If they do not reconcile, ask about the domestic delivery and provide the original order reference. An overseas carrier would have little to investigate at this stage.
corrections.translation: Jika tidak ada paket keluar yang memuat barang itu, periksa apakah barang masih tercatat di gudang atau menunggu tindakan Anda. Resi domestik penjual mungkin menunjukkan pengantaran ke alamat di Tiongkok. Itu sesuai dengan barang mencapai agen sebelum Anda mengatur pengiriman berikutnya. Cocokkan data pesanan dengan penerimaan gudang. Bila tidak sesuai, tanyakan pengiriman domestik dengan menyertakan nomor pesanan awal. Pengangkut internasional belum memiliki banyak hal untuk diperiksa pada tahap ini.

corrections.source: Open the tracking page of the carrier identified for your parcel. Copy the event wording, date, time and location exactly as shown. Also note when you checked and the name of the site reporting it. Keep a screenshot if the wording matters to a follow-up. An estimated delivery date at the top of a page is a forecast, while a timestamped event below it describes a recorded step. Save the two separately so a revised delivery estimate does not appear to overwrite an event.
corrections.translation: Buka halaman pelacakan pengangkut yang tercantum untuk paket Anda. Salin bunyi status, tanggal, waktu, dan lokasi persis seperti yang ditampilkan. Catat pula kapan Anda memeriksa dan nama situsnya. Simpan tangkapan layar jika kata-katanya akan dibahas. Perkiraan tanggal pengantaran di bagian atas merupakan prakiraan; peristiwa bertanda waktu di bawahnya adalah langkah yang tercatat. Simpan terpisah agar revisi prakiraan tidak terkesan menggantikan peristiwa sebelumnya.

corrections.source: Record a time zone when the page supplies one. An overseas scan shown in local facility time and an app notification stamped in the recipient's time can look out of order. If no zone is displayed, preserve the timestamp without converting it. The same applies to a city name: it can identify a facility that posted an update rather than the parcel's current physical position. A support question asking whether a handoff occurred after a named scan is more precise than asserting the parcel has been sitting in a particular building.
corrections.translation: Catat zona waktu jika tersedia. Pemindaian menurut waktu fasilitas di luar negeri dan pemberitahuan aplikasi menurut waktu penerima bisa terlihat tidak berurutan. Jika zona waktu tidak tercantum, simpan waktu aslinya tanpa konversi. Nama kota juga bisa menunjukkan fasilitas yang menerbitkan kabar, bukan lokasi fisik paket saat ini. Lebih tepat bertanya apakah penyerahan terjadi setelah pemindaian tertentu daripada menyatakan bahwa paket pasti masih berada di gedung itu.

corrections.source: Look for a second tracking reference or a named delivery partner on the outbound parcel record. Keep the first reference beside it, labelled with its carrier. When the page supplies a partner number, open the named carrier's official tracking page and compare its events. A package can have an international movement record and a separate final-delivery record. A search result that recognises a number does not, by itself, prove that the site's suggested carrier is responsible for your parcel. An explicit connection in the shipping record is stronger evidence.
corrections.translation: Cari nomor pelacakan kedua atau nama mitra pengantaran dalam catatan paket keluar. Simpan nomor pertama di sebelahnya berikut nama pengangkut masing-masing. Jika ada resi mitra, buka laman resmi mitra tersebut dan bandingkan peristiwa yang tercatat. Riwayat perjalanan internasional bisa terpisah dari riwayat pengantaran terakhir. Situs pencarian yang mengenali nomor belum membuktikan pengangkut yang disarankannya bertanggung jawab. Kaitan yang dinyatakan dalam catatan kiriman lebih kuat.

corrections.source: USPS, for example, distinguishes information received about a shipment from its own possession of the item. It also distinguishes an attempt from a completed delivery. Those distinctions can make sense of an apparent contradiction if USPS actually appears as the final carrier for your parcel. For a different route, use the named operator's explanation of the wording it displays. Keep its original wording if you translate the event for someone else. Two operators may use similar English phrases for different stages of a handoff.
corrections.translation: USPS, misalnya, membedakan penerimaan data kiriman dari penerimaan paket fisik. Percobaan pengantaran juga berbeda dari pengantaran yang selesai. Pembedaan tersebut membantu bila USPS memang tertera sebagai pengangkut terakhir paket Anda. Untuk rute lain, gunakan penjelasan operator yang benar-benar disebut. Simpan bunyi asli status ketika menerjemahkannya: dua operator bisa memakai istilah Inggris serupa untuk tahap penyerahan yang berbeda.

corrections.source: Imagine an order containing a jacket and scarf. On Monday the jacket's seller reference ends with a domestic delivery scan. On Thursday the jacket and scarf appear together in one international parcel record with another reference. Later a destination operator reports that it has received electronic information about that parcel. These events describe three different observations. The first supports checking warehouse receipt of the jacket, the second identifies your requested outbound contents, and the third records a message in the destination carrier's network.
corrections.translation: Misalkan pesanan memuat jaket dan syal. Pada Senin, resi domestik dari penjual jaket berakhir dengan pemindaian pengantaran. Kamis, jaket dan syal tercantum bersama pada paket internasional dengan nomor lain. Kemudian operator tujuan menyatakan sudah menerima data elektronik. Peristiwa pertama membantu mengecek penerimaan jaket di gudang, yang kedua menunjukkan isi yang Anda minta dikirim, dan yang ketiga mencatat pesan yang masuk ke jaringan operator tujuan.

corrections.source: Now suppose the international carrier reports a handover, while the destination operator still shows only the initial electronic event. Preserve both dated messages. You can ask whether the named partner has a physical acceptance event or whether another reference was issued. You cannot settle that question by counting the number of days since the seller's Monday delivery. That scan belonged to the earlier domestic journey. Keeping the reference next to every event prevents an old successful delivery from masking a genuinely unresolved international handoff.
corrections.translation: Andaikata pengangkut internasional mencatat serah terima sementara operator tujuan masih hanya menampilkan data elektronik awal. Simpan kedua pesan dengan tanggalnya. Tanyakan apakah mitra sudah mencatat penerimaan fisik atau menerbitkan nomor baru. Menghitung hari sejak penjual mengantar jaket pada Senin tidak menjawabnya, karena pemindaian itu untuk perjalanan domestik sebelumnya. Mencatat nomor di samping setiap peristiwa mencegah pengantaran lama menutupi pertanyaan tentang serah terima internasional.

corrections.source: A pickup or attempted-delivery notice can require a different response from a parcel moving between facilities. Read the carrier's full message for the pickup location, redelivery options, required identification or action deadline, as applicable to the service shown. Reach the carrier through the tracking page or contact information you verified from its official site. If a text arrives asking for money or new address details, independently reopen the carrier's site before acting on it. A message containing a familiar parcel number can still be unrelated to an official delivery request.
corrections.translation: Pemberitahuan pengambilan atau percobaan pengantaran memerlukan respons berbeda dari perpindahan antarfasilitas. Baca pesan lengkap mengenai lokasi pengambilan, opsi pengantaran ulang, identitas, atau tenggat yang berlaku. Hubungi pengangkut melalui halaman pelacakan atau kontak yang Anda verifikasi dari situs resminya. Jika pesan singkat meminta uang atau alamat baru, buka sendiri situs resmi sebelum menindaklanjuti. Nomor paket yang dikenal dalam pesan belum menjadikannya permintaan resmi.

corrections.source: If the event says delivered, compare the reported date and delivery location with your own circumstances. Check the normal receiving point, building reception or another location the carrier explicitly identifies. Ask other people who are authorised to receive your deliveries. Preserve any proof-of-delivery information the carrier makes available to you. Where the location remains unclear, state exactly what you checked when asking for assistance. Avoid publishing a delivery photograph, complete label or tracking reference on a public forum, where it can reveal information about the recipient.
corrections.translation: Jika status menyatakan sudah diantar, cocokkan tanggal serta lokasi dengan keadaan Anda. Periksa titik penerimaan biasa, resepsionis gedung, atau tempat lain yang disebut pengangkut. Tanyakan pada orang yang berwenang menerima paket Anda. Simpan bukti pengantaran yang disediakan. Jika lokasi tetap tidak jelas, jelaskan tepat apa saja yang telah diperiksa ketika meminta bantuan. Jangan memublikasikan foto pengantaran, label lengkap, atau nomor resi di forum karena dapat mengungkap data penerima.

corrections.source: Start with one question and the identifiers needed to answer it. For example: your outbound parcel shows the international carrier's handoff event on the stated date, while the named destination carrier still shows an information-only event. Ask whether there is an updated final-mile reference or a physical acceptance record. Supply the private parcel reference, the carrier names and the relevant latest events. The official OOTDBuy help and contact pages are starting points for a question about the agent's own parcel record.
corrections.translation: Mulai dengan satu pertanyaan dan nomor yang diperlukan untuk menjawabnya. Misalnya, catatan paket keluar menunjukkan serah terima oleh pengangkut internasional pada tanggal tertentu, tetapi operator tujuan hanya menerima data. Tanyakan apakah tersedia nomor baru untuk tahap pengantaran akhir atau catatan penerimaan fisik. Berikan secara pribadi nomor paket, nama pengangkut, dan peristiwa terakhir masing-masing. Halaman bantuan dan kontak resmi OOTDBuy adalah titik awal untuk menanyakan catatan paket milik agen.

corrections.source: A request about a delivered parcel should identify the date and carrier location shown, the receiving points already checked and the fact that the recipient has not located it. Review the carrier's current instructions for reporting that particular status. Check the agent's applicable after-sales terms for any reporting window or evidence requirements. Keep these details with the specific parcel, since routes and services can differ. A generic promised wait or an assumed compensation amount could lead you to miss the instruction that actually applies to your shipment.
corrections.translation: Untuk paket berstatus sudah diantar tetapi belum ditemukan, sebutkan tanggal dan lokasi menurut pengangkut, titik penerimaan yang sudah diperiksa, dan bahwa penerima belum menemukan barang. Baca prosedur pengangkut untuk status tersebut serta ketentuan purnajual agen tentang batas waktu dan bukti. Simpan bersama catatan paket itu karena layanan dan rute dapat berbeda. Mengandalkan waktu tunggu atau jumlah kompensasi yang diasumsikan bisa membuat Anda melewatkan petunjuk yang sebenarnya berlaku.

corrections.source: Track each reply by who provided it and what it established. A support case number confirms that someone opened an inquiry. A corrected final-mile reference can make a previously invisible tracking history available. A message that the carrier will investigate is still an open step. Keep the next expected action and any stated follow-up date beside the case. If a later scan arrives, add it beneath the previous one instead of replacing the record that prompted the inquiry.
corrections.translation: Catat siapa yang memberikan setiap jawaban dan hal yang sudah dipastikan. Nomor kasus berarti penyelidikan dibuka. Koreksi nomor pengantaran akhir bisa memperlihatkan riwayat yang sebelumnya tidak terlihat. Pesan bahwa pengangkut akan menyelidiki tetap merupakan langkah yang belum selesai. Catat tindakan berikutnya dan tanggal tindak lanjut jika ada. Tambahkan pemindaian baru di bawah peristiwa lama agar alasan awal Anda meminta bantuan tidak hilang.

corrections.source: When you receive the parcel, compare the label with the outbound reference and check the contents against the items assigned to it. If the parcel arrived but one garment is missing, close the delivery question and open a contents question with the relevant packaging and item evidence. If support confirms another outcome, retain the written resolution and identify precisely which parcel it covers. The result should let another reader tell which delivery was completed, which issue was investigated and whether any separate purchase is still in transit.
corrections.translation: Sesudah paket diterima, cocokkan label dengan nomor paket keluar dan isi dengan daftar barang. Jika paket tiba tetapi satu pakaian tidak ada, akhiri pertanyaan pengantaran dan buka pertanyaan terpisah mengenai isi, dengan bukti kemasan dan barang yang diterima. Jika petugas menetapkan hasil lain, simpan keputusan tertulis dan sebutkan paket mana yang dimaksud. Catatan akhir harus memperjelas kiriman yang selesai, masalah yang diselidiki, dan pembelian terpisah yang mungkin masih dalam perjalanan.

corrections.source: You send a friend the link to the navy sweatshirt in size large. They open it and see a white sweatshirt in small. The link may still point to the correct product. What failed to travel with it was the selection. Save a listing address and a short option record together, then test the result in a fresh tab before you rely on it for an order.
corrections.translation: Bila Anda membagikan tautan sweter biru tua ukuran L tetapi teman melihat warna putih ukuran S, halaman produknya mungkin benar. Tautannya hanya tidak menyimpan pilihan. Simpan alamat beserta warna dan ukuran, lalu uji di tab baru sebelum memesan.

corrections.source: A product card can reasonably offer more than one destination. The original marketplace listing helps you check the seller, options and description. An agent purchase link helps a buyer open the item with the intended purchasing service. The address of a catalogue page helps someone retrace where the find appeared. Each one answers a different request. When another person asks for the Weidian link, give them the seller address and identify the agent link separately if they also want that.
corrections.translation: Kartu produk bisa memuat beberapa tautan. Halaman pasar asal menunjukkan penjual, opsi dan deskripsi. Tautan agen membuka jalur pemesanan, sedangkan halaman katalog menunjukkan tempat produk ditemukan. Bila orang meminta tautan Weidian, kirim alamat penjual dan tandai tautan agen secara terpisah bila diminta.

corrections.source: Copy the link attached to the relevant product rather than the address of the results page where you found it. A category or search URL can show a different order of results tomorrow. Avoid copying a picture address from the gallery. A picture address opens an image; it cannot tell the recipient who sells the item, which size is available or what the current price is. Open what you copied and look at the destination before sharing it.
corrections.translation: Salin tautan produk yang dimaksud. Urutan barang di hasil pencarian atau halaman kategori bisa berubah besok. Alamat gambar hanya membuka gambar, sehingga orang tidak bisa melihat penjual, ukuran tersedia atau harga terkini. Uji alamat yang disalin sebelum membagikannya.

corrections.source: Weidian product links often carry an itemID parameter. Record the marketplace and its itemID together where the link exposes it. Keep a separate field for a shop identifier, an agent order number or your own spreadsheet row. These numbers may all appear in an ordering workflow, but they identify different things. If a recipient asks why two versions open to the same item, first see whether both links have the same marketplace item identifier. They may simply be options within one offer.
corrections.translation: Alamat produk Weidian sering memuat parameter itemID. Catat bersama nama pasarnya, di kolom terpisah dari ID toko, nomor pesanan agen dan nomor baris lembar kerja. Jika dua tautan membuka barang yang sama, bandingkan ID produknya. Keduanya mungkin hanya varian dari satu penawaran.

corrections.source: A short sharing link may redirect before the seller page opens. Let it reach its destination and check the shop and product shown there. Keep the original link if it is the only one you can verify. Making up a shorter address by deleting everything after a question mark can remove the very identifier that tells the site what to load. If you want a cleaner link, compare the full destinations yourself after the edit. Preserve the tested address in your private notes.
corrections.translation: Lewati pengalihan pada tautan pendek dan periksa toko serta produk akhirnya. Simpan alamat yang terbukti benar. Menghapus semua teks setelah tanda tanya bisa ikut membuang ID barang. Bila ingin merapikan tautan, buka versi lama dan baru lalu bandingkan tujuan akhirnya.

corrections.source: For most clothing finds, record the colour or version text, selected size and quantity. If there is a seller code beside the translation, keep it. Add the unit whenever a set or pack is involved. “Two blue” leaves open whether you mean two single shirts, two sets or the second blue version in the selector. “Blue B, large, quantity two, one shirt per unit” gives another person a selection they can reproduce and a quantity they can check at checkout.
corrections.translation: Catat warna atau model, ukuran, jumlah dan kode asli penjual jika ada. Jelaskan isi per unit. “Dua biru” bisa berarti dua kemeja, dua set, atau pilihan warna biru kedua. “Biru B, ukuran L, dua unit, satu kemeja per unit” bisa dicocokkan saat pembayaran.

corrections.source: A screenshot can supplement the note but it is not a substitute for selectable text. On a phone, a long option may be truncated with an ellipsis. Tap through to the full description or save a wider view if available. Attach the screenshot to the same note as the seller URL. If you send images and links separately in a long chat, mark them with a short shared reference like “navy sweatshirt B.” The recipient can then keep the correct screenshot if you later send an alternative.
corrections.translation: Lengkapi catatan dengan tangkapan layar dan teks opsi yang dapat disalin. Ponsel kadang memotong keterangan panjang, jadi buka keterangan lengkap bila tersedia. Satukan foto dan URL penjual. Jika dikirim terpisah, pakai penanda yang sama, misalnya “sweter biru tua B”.

corrections.source: Open a fresh tab and paste the copied URL. See which colour, size and package choice are actually selected. Repeat the check with a second version from the same listing. If both links reopen with the same default, the link is useful at the listing level and your note must carry the option. If the URL does restore the selected variant, keep the text anyway. It gives the recipient a human-readable check if the seller edits the options later.
corrections.translation: Tempel URL di tab baru dan lihat warna, ukuran serta paket yang benar-benar terpilih. Ulangi dengan varian kedua dari halaman itu. Jika keduanya kembali ke pilihan bawaan, catatan Anda harus memuat variannya. Bahkan jika tautan memulihkannya dengan benar, simpan teks opsi untuk mencocokkan perubahan berikutnya.

corrections.source: Check the price after reproducing the selection. Imagine a sweatshirt page that also offers a drawstring accessory. A link opening to the accessory may show a dramatically lower starting figure than the amount attached to the sweatshirt. Record the selected unit price with its currency, and say when you saw it. A recipient can then tell whether the apparent discrepancy comes from a default option or a change in the offer. Use the live checkout amount when paying.
corrections.translation: Periksa harga setelah memilih varian yang benar. Halaman sweter yang juga menawarkan tali serut bisa menampilkan harga awal tali yang jauh lebih rendah. Catat harga satuan, mata uang, dan waktu pengecekan. Ini membantu membedakan perubahan harga dari opsi bawaan. Saat membayar, gunakan angka terkini pada halaman pembayaran.

corrections.source: Suppose the recipient wants to use OOTDBuy, while the person who originally shared the find used another agent. Start from the saved marketplace listing. Open it through the desired purchasing route and compare the resulting seller, item and available options. Use the colour and size note you recorded, paying particular attention to shortened translations. If two labels now look identical, the source codes or original wording can resolve the ambiguity.
corrections.translation: Jika penerima memakai OOTDBuy sementara pengirim memakai agen lain, mulailah dari halaman penjual asli dan buka lewat jalur pembelian yang diinginkan. Bandingkan penjual, barang, ukuran dan warna dengan catatan. Bila terjemahan singkat membuat dua label tampak sama, gunakan teks atau kode asli untuk membedakannya.

corrections.source: An agent view that shows only a generic title or one photo leaves missing information. Before submitting a manual request, write down the complete purchase instruction and identify the one thing that still needs confirmation. For example, “Please order the navy B version, size L, two single shirts. Contact me if this version has sold out.” Avoid instructions like “same as photo” if the photo shows a model wearing multiple products. It leaves the person placing the order to decide what is included.
corrections.translation: Jika halaman agen hanya menampilkan judul umum atau satu gambar, tulis instruksi lengkap sebelum meminta pembelian manual. Misalnya, “Biru tua versi B ukuran L, dua kemeja satuan. Hubungi saya jika habis.” Keterangan “seperti foto” tidak menjelaskan barang yang dimaksud ketika model mengenakan beberapa produk.

corrections.source: A dead link deserves a status entry of its own. Give the date, the marketplace and the item identifier if known. When a seller offers a replacement link, compare the new seller name, size chart, option description and current price. If the replacement has a different item number, save it on a new row. Historical pictures under the old row may still illustrate a design feature but cannot establish what the new seller will supply.
corrections.translation: Untuk tautan mati, catat tanggal, pasar dan ID barang bila diketahui. Periksa nama penjual, tabel ukuran, keterangan varian dan harga saat menerima tautan pengganti. Buat baris baru jika nomor barang berbeda. Foto lama bisa menjelaskan desain tetapi tidak membuktikan apa yang dikirim penjual baru.

corrections.source: If the page loads and your exact option is greyed out, distinguish that case from a dead listing. Write “page available, navy B in L currently unavailable” rather than marking the entire find as broken. A second buyer looking for medium can still check that option. A buyer who needs large now knows what to ask about. The difference also matters when updating a shared spreadsheet: deleting an entire row can hide other choices that remain usable.
corrections.translation: Jika halaman aktif tetapi opsi yang dibutuhkan berwarna abu-abu, catat “halaman aktif, biru tua B ukuran L sedang tidak tersedia”. Orang yang mencari ukuran M masih dapat memeriksa pilihannya. Menghapus seluruh baris bisa menyembunyikan varian yang masih dijual.

corrections.source: A concise handoff can fit in one message. Include the tested seller link, the intended agent link if requested, the option text, size, quantity and anything that requires confirmation. Keep private order numbers out of a public sheet. For a personal purchase, put the order reference in a separate private record once the transaction is placed. That division lets a shared link remain useful to other readers without revealing which order belongs to whom.
corrections.translation: Satukan tautan penjual yang diuji, tautan agen jika diminta, opsi, ukuran, jumlah dan hal yang perlu dikonfirmasi dalam satu pesan. Simpan nomor pesanan pribadi di catatan terpisah setelah transaksi. Lembar bersama tetap dapat digunakan tanpa mengungkap siapa pemilik suatu pesanan.

corrections.source: Before you close the tab, ask whether a stranger could reproduce your choice from the material you saved. They should know where the listing comes from, which option to select and which parts are still uncertain. If the answer depends on remembering that “the second picture meant the long version,” add those words now. This final minute of checking is especially worthwhile for a multi-style Weidian listing. It makes the copied link a practical buying reference, even on a device that has never opened it before.
corrections.translation: Sebelum menutup halaman, periksa apakah orang yang baru melihatnya bisa mengulangi pilihan Anda. Ia perlu tahu sumber, varian dan apa yang masih belum pasti. Jika “gambar kedua berarti model panjang” hanya tersimpan dalam ingatan Anda, tuliskan. Langkah singkat ini membantu pembaca membuka halaman Weidian multivarian di perangkat lain.

corrections.source: Take a jacket from your wardrobe that fits the way you want these purchases to fit. Try it on with the layer you expect to wear. Raise your arms, zip the front and sit down. Write down the one feature that feels right and one you might change. Perhaps its chest is comfortable over a sweater but its cuffs ride up. This note makes your comparison more useful than a list of measurements taken without a purpose. You are choosing a fit for an activity, not trying to duplicate every dimension.
corrections.translation: Pilih jaket milik Anda yang pas. Coba bersama lapisan pakaian yang ingin dikenakan, tutup ritsleting, angkat tangan dan duduk. Catat aspek yang menentukan kenyamanan, misalnya ruang gerak bahu atau posisi ujung jaket. Gunakan jaket yang sama untuk membandingkan kedua toko.

corrections.source: Lay the reference flat on a firm surface. Empty the pockets, straighten the seams and close the garment as you did when trying it on. Keep the tape level without pulling the fabric taut. Measure once, lift the tape, then measure again. If your two readings differ, note what moved. A thick fleece can bunch at the underarm, while an unfastened front can spread wider the second time. Resolve that small uncertainty at home before interpreting a difference of a centimetre in a chart.
corrections.translation: Letakkan jaket acuan di permukaan rata dan kokoh, kosongkan saku, rapikan jahitan dan tutup bagian depan seperti saat dicoba. Jaga pita ukur tetap lurus tanpa meregangkan kain. Ukur kembali setelah mengangkat dan meletakkan ulang jaket. Catat variasi hasil dan metode yang digunakan.

corrections.source: Read the headings and the accompanying diagram as a pair. A body chart recommends a size for a person with certain measurements. A garment chart describes the piece that person will wear. You cannot compare a body chest circumference directly with the width of a jacket laid on a table. Fabric, lining, cut and room for movement separate those values. If the listing does not tell you which type of chart you are looking at, keep that field unresolved.
corrections.translation: Baca judul kolom dan diagram bersama. Tabel tubuh merekomendasikan ukuran untuk orang dengan ukuran badan tertentu, sedangkan tabel pakaian mengukur pakaian jadi. Pastikan apakah angka menyatakan lebar saat dibentangkan atau keliling sebelum membandingkannya dengan jaket acuan.

corrections.source: Length is often the measurement that exposes an otherwise attractive comparison. One seller may start at the high shoulder beside the neck; another may measure down the centre back from the collar seam. A decorative collar or a dropped rear hem makes the difference especially noticeable. Look for the start and finish in the seller's diagram, then take both measurements on your reference jacket. Label them with the endpoints instead of keeping a single number called length.
corrections.translation: Penjual bisa mengukur panjang dari bahu dekat leher atau dari jahitan kerah di tengah punggung. Ujung pakaian depan dan belakang juga bisa berbeda panjang. Ulangi kedua metode pada pakaian acuan agar tiap angka dibandingkan dengan jalur ukur yang sesuai.

corrections.source: Put a conventional shoulder jacket beside a drop-shoulder sweatshirt. The sleeve seam starts at a different point on the arm, so comparable cuff placement can come from very different sleeve lengths in a chart. A raglan piece creates another complication because its seam runs diagonally toward the neck. Compare like construction where possible. When two pieces differ, a neck-to-cuff measurement with explicit endpoints can provide a more useful common reference than the sleeve seam alone.
corrections.translation: Posisi awal jahitan lengan jaket biasa berbeda dari sweter berbahu turun. Manset bisa jatuh di titik yang sama meskipun panjang lengan pada tabel berbeda. Pada model raglan, periksa apakah penjual mengukur dari leher dan ikuti jalur yang sama pada pakaian acuan.

corrections.source: To check a photograph, trace the path of the tape with your eye. Is the cuff turned up? Is the sleeve bent or stretched? Does the zero mark sit on the seam you requested? A close crop of the final number can be completely legible and still answer the wrong question. If you have only one additional view available, request a single frame showing the entire path. Include the size and colour in the request so the photographer measures the item you plan to keep.
corrections.translation: Telusuri pita ukur dari awal sampai akhir pada foto. Apakah manset dilipat, lengan bengkok atau kain ditarik? Apakah tanda nol berada tepat di jahitan yang diminta? Potongan gambar yang hanya memperlihatkan angka akhir tidak menjawabnya. Minta gambar yang mencakup seluruh jalur pengukuran.

corrections.source: A sweatshirt-and-trousers set may use one size selector even though the top and bottom have separate charts. Compare both pieces before choosing. For trousers, decide which measurement matters most for your use: relaxed waist, seat width, rise, inseam or the opening that must pass over your shoe. A seller's flat relaxed waist tells you something different from a stretched maximum. Ask whether a quoted pair of values represents a measurement range or the ends of two different sizes.
corrections.translation: Set sweter dan celana bisa memakai satu pilihan ukuran meskipun tabel atasannya berbeda dari tabel celana. Bandingkan keduanya. Periksa ukuran pinggang saat rileks atau diregangkan, panjang sisi dalam kaki, atau panjang keseluruhan sesuai bagian yang penting bagi Anda.

corrections.source: Suppose the top in medium matches your reference and the trousers in medium are too short. Moving to large may increase the trousers' length while making the top wider than you like. Write these two outcomes on separate lines. Then check whether the seller allows mixed sizes for that particular option. A model photograph showing two pieces together gives no answer about the order form. If mixed sizing is unavailable, decide which compromise you are willing to wear before committing to the set.
corrections.translation: Jika atasan ukuran M pas tetapi celana M terlalu pendek, ukuran L mungkin memberi panjang yang cukup sekaligus membuat atasan terlalu lebar. Catat kedua akibatnya. Periksa apakah penjual menyediakan ukuran terpisah dan pertimbangkan komprominya jika harus membeli satu set.

corrections.source: Do not give a chart more precision than the measurement supports. A difference of a few millimetres should be considered alongside the seller's stated tolerance, your own repeat readings and the behaviour of the fabric. If no tolerance is given, avoid inventing one. A thick quilted piece can have a generous external measurement and feel snug inside. Use garment construction and the intended underlayer to decide when a close comparison still leaves an important question open.
corrections.translation: Selisih beberapa milimeter harus dibaca bersama toleransi penjual, variasi pengukuran ulang, dan daya regang kain. Jika selisihnya masih dalam rentang tersebut, hindari kesimpulan pasti tentang ukuran terbaik. Mintalah ukuran barang yang sebenarnya jika itu menentukan keputusan.

corrections.source: A useful note identifies the chosen option, reference garment, measurement method and remaining uncertainty. For example: “Considering listing B, large, black. Finished chest is closest to my winter jacket. Centre-back length confirmed. Ask for neck-to-cuff because the shoulders are cut differently.” The note lets you return to the listing without repeating every calculation. Save the chart image or seller description alongside it, particularly if several versions share one product page.
corrections.translation: Catat opsi, warna, ukuran, pakaian acuan, cara mengukur dan hal yang masih meragukan. Misalnya, “Model B hitam ukuran L. Lebar dada mendekati jaket musim dingin saya, tetapi panjang dari tengah punggung masih perlu dikonfirmasi.” Gudang pun tahu pengukuran apa yang diperlukan.

corrections.source: When the warehouse entry is available, compare the actual item against the decision you recorded. Use the OOTDBuy order channel if you need an item-specific measurement, and review the current inspection information in the Help Center. You have finished the comparison when you can explain why one size meets your needs and which evidence supports that conclusion. If a necessary measurement remains missing, keeping the row pending is a perfectly defensible result.
corrections.translation: Setelah barang masuk gudang, bandingkan dengan catatan pilihan Anda. Gunakan kanal pesanan OOTDBuy untuk meminta pengukuran pada unit tersebut dan periksa cakupan layanan inspeksi saat ini. Simpan foto bersama referensi varian sebelum memutuskan pengiriman.

corrections.source: One frame shows a backpack with an outside zip pocket, a close-up shows a smooth front, and another picture includes a small shoulder strap. All three images appear beneath the same product title. Which bag are you actually looking at? A gallery often combines several kinds of evidence. Read it in a deliberate order and use the gaps to formulate a question about the precise version you intend to buy.
corrections.translation: Satu foto ransel menunjukkan saku ritsleting luar, foto detail menunjukkan bagian depan polos, dan foto lain memiliki tali bahu tambahan. Semuanya berada di halaman yang sama. Tentukan foto mana yang terikat dengan opsi terpilih sebelum menyimpulkan isi pesanan.

corrections.source: Find the clearest complete view of the item. Look at its shape, opening, panel lines and the way accessories attach. Use a few fixed landmarks that remain visible even if the camera angle changes. On a backpack those might be the number of zip tracks, the shape of the main flap and the position of the strap anchors. On a jacket you might choose the collar, front fastening and lower pockets. These landmarks give the other photographs something to connect to.
corrections.translation: Mulailah dengan tampilan ransel utuh yang paling jelas. Periksa bentuk, bukaan, sambungan panel, dan posisi aksesori. Gunakan penanda yang tetap terlihat dari beberapa sudut, misalnya jalur ritsleting atau pangkal pegangan, untuk menghubungkan foto detail dengan tasnya.

corrections.source: Write a literal description before judging quality. “Two zip tracks meet above a rectangular front panel” captures evidence another reader can check. “Looks like the premium version” puts an interpretation ahead of the details. This pays off when the same gallery includes more than one release. You can match a close-up of a zip pull to the bag with the corresponding track arrangement. If the landmarks cannot be seen in the close-up, leave its relationship to the main picture open.
corrections.translation: Catat ciri harfiah, misalnya “dua jalur ritsleting bertemu di atas panel depan berbentuk persegi panjang”. Orang lain bisa mengeceknya. “Kelihatannya versi premium” sudah merupakan kesimpulan yang belum tentu didukung gambar.

corrections.source: Select the colour or model you want and observe which pictures change with it. Keep the selected text visible when you save a reference. A seller may use one promotional hero image for the whole listing and reserve the smaller swatch image for the exact option. Alternatively, the swatches may all use the same picture with different written codes. In either case, changing the selection is a useful test because it shows whether the interface associates a particular picture with an option.
corrections.translation: Pilih warna atau model dan lihat foto mana yang ikut berubah. Simpan tangkapan layar yang juga menampilkan teks opsi. Penjual mungkin memakai satu foto utama untuk seluruh varian. Foto yang tidak berubah belum membuktikan fitur varian pilihan Anda.

corrections.source: Consider a bag listing with compact and full-size versions. Both versions might have the same colourway and nearly identical front styling. A picture that changes when you switch from black to green says little about which size has been selected. Toggle only the size and check again. If no photograph changes, read the written dimensions for the chosen size. A photograph of the bag worn by a model may offer context, but the model's proportions and camera perspective make it unsuitable as the only size evidence.
corrections.translation: Ransel ukuran ringkas dan penuh bisa memiliki warna serta desain depan yang sama. Perubahan foto saat memilih hitam atau hijau tidak membuktikan ukuran yang ditampilkan. Cocokkan nama varian, ukuran dan ciri bentuknya.

corrections.source: A close-up can reveal stitching, texture or the shape of a fastening. To relate it to the item, look for an intermediate view showing where that detail sits. A picture of an isolated clasp is weaker evidence for a detachable strap than a view showing the clasp attached to the strap and its attachment ring on the bag. If the strap determines whether you will buy, look for the option description listing it among the supplied pieces. A gallery can show an optional accessory for styling.
corrections.translation: Foto dekat menunjukkan jahitan, tekstur atau bentuk pengait. Cari foto jarak menengah yang memperlihatkan letak detail itu pada tas. Pengait tanpa konteks memberi petunjuk lebih lemah daripada gambar pengait yang terlihat terpasang pada talinya.

corrections.source: Zoom only as far as the image resolution supports. Sharpening or enlarging a low-resolution crop cannot reveal a character on an unreadable label with confidence. The same applies to texture. A reflection on a smooth coated surface can resemble a crease, while compression artefacts can make a straight seam look jagged. Mark the observation and ask for a clear view of that area if it would change your purchase decision. A precise request is more useful than a verdict from a handful of pixels.
corrections.translation: Perbesar foto hanya sejauh resolusinya mendukung. Penajaman tidak membuat huruf pada label buram menjadi bukti yang andal. Kilau pada bahan juga bisa sekadar pantulan. Jika bahan atau tulisan menentukan pembelian, minta foto jelas pada bagian itu.

corrections.source: A dimension drawing, colour chart or instructions panel can appear between photographs with little explanation. Check the labels around it. The diagram may apply to the whole family, a named model or the packaging rather than the product. In the backpack example, outside dimensions do not give the exact dimensions of an internal laptop sleeve. Padding, rounded corners and an opening narrower than the body all matter. Ask for sleeve width and usable opening if you need to carry a specific object.
corrections.translation: Diagram ukuran, tabel warna dan panel petunjuk bisa tersisip di antara foto. Baca keterangannya untuk mengetahui apakah berlaku untuk semua model, varian tertentu atau kemasan. Ukuran luar ransel tidak menentukan lebar bukaan kompartemen laptop. Minta ukuran bukaan itu bila diperlukan.

corrections.source: If you compare a drawing to a product photograph, make sure the orientation agrees. The length shown along the bottom of a bag is different from the usable internal depth. A side view with a gusset folded inward may understate how the bag looks when filled. Keep the seller's named measurement and unit with your note. If a graphic is in another language, retain the original label alongside the translation so you can revisit it if the interpretation seems inconsistent.
corrections.translation: Samakan arah diagram dan foto. Panjang dasar tas berbeda dari kedalaman ruang dalam yang bisa digunakan. Panel samping yang terlipat juga bisa membuat tas tampak lebih sempit. Tentukan arah dan kedua ujung ukuran sebelum membandingkan angka.

corrections.source: A warehouse reference may show an ordinary unit under simple light and make proportions easier to understand. Check its source and any accompanying item or option information. An old picture attached to a marketplace identifier remains a record of that photographed unit. It does not establish which option the seller sends now. If the website does not identify a photograph as a warehouse image, describe it simply as a gallery photograph. A plain background alone cannot identify who took it.
corrections.translation: Foto referensi gudang dapat menunjukkan proporsi barang dalam cahaya biasa. Periksa sumber, informasi produk dan variannya. Foto lama pada halaman dengan beberapa model belum menjamin unit yang Anda terima memiliki detail yang sama.

corrections.source: Suppose a historical shot shows a removable organizer inside the backpack. The selected seller option describes only the bag. The right question is whether the organizer belongs to that option today. A second image of another customer's organizer might confirm that the accessory exists without answering whether it is included. Record the strongest conclusion you can actually support, then ask for confirmation of the missing part of the claim.
corrections.translation: Bila foto lama memperlihatkan kantong penyekat yang dapat dilepas, sedangkan opsi sekarang hanya mencantumkan ransel, tanyakan apakah kantong itu termasuk pembelian saat ini. Foto kedua yang tidak menampilkannya belum membuktikan bahwa kantong disertakan atau ditiadakan.

corrections.source: You do not need to annotate every image. List the contradictions that affect your requirements. For the backpack you might record three: the outside pocket appears only in the studio picture, the dark green option has no front view, and the sleeve drawing has no internal width. Beside each, identify the simplest evidence that would settle it. A front photograph of the selected bag answers two of those questions at once. A measurement of the sleeve opening addresses the third.
corrections.translation: Catat pertentangan yang memengaruhi pembelian, misalnya saku luar hanya terlihat pada foto studio, warna hijau tua belum jelas, dan lebar bukaan kompartemen laptop belum diketahui. Urutkan berdasarkan hal yang benar-benar menentukan pilihan.

corrections.source: Send the request with the seller option text and a description of the relevant location. “Please show the front of the dark green full-size bag, then the width of its laptop sleeve opening with the tape visible” gives the reader a reproducible task. If the item is in your order, add its reference in the private OOTDBuy order channel. For available inspection services and the stage at which you can request them, consult the official Help Center and the current order interface.
corrections.translation: Cantumkan teks opsi penjual dan letak detailnya. Misalnya, “Mohon foto depan ransel hijau tua ukuran penuh, lalu foto lebar bukaan kompartemen laptop dengan kedua ujung pita ukur terlihat.” Permintaan yang spesifik memudahkan pemeriksaan unit yang benar.

corrections.source: When reviewing pictures of your own unit, bring back the same landmarks and the same contradiction list. Match the order option first. Then decide whether the photographs answer your essential requirements. A visible outside zip answers the pocket question; it does not establish laptop clearance. A sleeve measurement can support your size decision but does not settle whether a detachable organizer is included. Keep each conclusion with the evidence that supports it.
corrections.translation: Saat foto unit Anda tersedia, cocokkan variannya dahulu. Kembali ke penanda dan daftar pertanyaan awal. Foto yang menunjukkan adanya kompartemen laptop belum tentu menunjukkan lebar bukaannya. Catat apa yang sudah terjawab dan ukuran yang masih dibutuhkan.

corrections.source: At the end you should be able to explain the choice in plain terms. You might decide that the exact shade matters little, that a usable sleeve opening matters a great deal, and that the organizer can be purchased separately. Someone with different priorities can reasonably reach another conclusion from the same photographs. A good reading of an OOTDBuy gallery gives you that freedom. It turns a long, sometimes inconsistent collection of pictures into a short set of observations that actually changes what you do.
corrections.translation: Rangkum keputusan dengan alasan konkret. Perbedaan warna kecil mungkin dapat diterima, bukaan kompartemen laptop harus cukup lebar, dan kantong penyekat bisa dibeli terpisah. Simpan gambar serta jawaban yang mendukung syarat terpenting Anda.
